wording: v2 (PACKROUTE-2 declared retry): the v1 descriptions unchanged + 3 example question stems per pack, written from each card's domain line (not taken from any self-test, v0.1 or v0.2 item); fixed before the rerun
none: the question is general or about travel/crypto, which the base app already covers

qa-travel-se.description: Travel Stack Exchange Q&A: travellers' practical questions on visas, border and customs rules, airlines, airports, transit and overstays.
examples: Can I transit through Frankfurt airport without a Schengen visa?
What happens if I overstay my tourist visa by one day?
Will my checked bag be transferred if my two flights are on separate tickets?

qa-ethereum-se.description: Ethereum Stack Exchange Q&A: Ethereum development questions on Solidity, smart contracts, web3 libraries, clients, gas, EIPs and wallets.
examples: Why does my Solidity function revert with out of gas?
How do I listen for contract events with web3.js?
What does the base fee in EIP-1559 do?

qa-bitcoin-se.description: Bitcoin Stack Exchange Q&A: questions on the Bitcoin protocol, transactions, scripts, keys, wallets, mining, nodes and Lightning.
examples: How does a node check a transaction's signatures?
Why has my Bitcoin transaction stayed unconfirmed for days?
What happens when a Lightning channel is force-closed?

qa-health-se.description: Medical Sciences Stack Exchange Q&A: health and medical explanation questions on the body, diseases, drugs, treatments and research evidence.
examples: Why does caffeine seem to stop working if I drink coffee every day?
Is there evidence that cracking knuckles causes arthritis?
How do antihistamines cause drowsiness?

qa-outdoors-se.description: Outdoors Stack Exchange Q&A: hiking, camping, backpacking, gear, navigation, wildlife, wilderness skills and outdoor safety questions.
examples: How do I stop condensation inside my tent at night?
What should I do if I meet a bear on the trail?
How warm a sleeping bag do I need for nights below freezing?

boar-firstaid-en.description: First aid and preparedness: emergency first aid, casualty care, disaster readiness, survival skills, water, shelter and self-reliance (Wikipedia, Appropedia, US Army manuals).
examples: How do I stop heavy bleeding from a leg wound?
How can I make water safe to drink after a flood?
What should a home emergency kit contain?

boar-medlineplus-en.description: MedlinePlus health topics: US National Library of Medicine plain-language summaries of diseases, conditions, symptoms, tests, treatments and wellness.
examples: What are the symptoms of type 2 diabetes?
How is a thyroid function test done?
What treatments are there for shingles?

boar-factbook.description: CIA World Factbook: per-country facts (capital, population, area, languages, government, economy, geography, military) for every country, territory and ocean.
examples: What is the population of Peru?
Which languages are spoken in Belgium?
What currency does Kenya use?

boar-simplewiki-en.description: Simple English Wikipedia: about 208,000 plain-English encyclopedia articles on people, places, history, science, nature and culture.
examples: Who was Ada Lovelace?
What is photosynthesis?
When did the Western Roman Empire fall?
